about: Landmarks left out of locations.json after their pictures were looked at, by placement (map, wmo: wmo_placement unique_id), so a new run of scripts/pick.ts keeps them out and fills their zone from the next best. by: draft (proposed from the contact sheets, waiting on the user eye pass), user, or render (it never rendered: the installed client lacks the area files, so the entry goes once the client has them). Near-duplicates (the same model or the same name twice in a zone) are not listed: the picker keeps one of each (src/landmarks.ts choose). empty: a zone left with no picture on purpose, with why (test/locations.test.ts refuses any other).

empty.why: its two landmarks, both at Fire Plume Ridge, render as nothing to guess from, and it has no other WMO standing on open ground (Marshal's Refuge is a cave, its box under the hill). Its places are terrain and doodads (crystals, the tar pits), and wow-data has no model names to tell a crystal from a tree. The crystal pylons are game objects, which the renderer does not draw.
